notes.title: Patch Updates #06
notes.content:
[b]Additions and Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Removed the bottles mechanic along with all the bottles in the game
[*] Added Checkpoints on the first Boss so when you die you can load the game from the latest checkpoint.
[*] Added a missing file for Alegra Case (within Journal entries)
[*] Removed the "Perfectionist Achievement"
[/list]


[b]Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where during the Police Station area if you used the disk and then save and load the game, the PC won't let you continue.
[*] Fixed a bug where some tutorials would remain locked in the tutorials menu screen.
[*] Fixed some blurry textures when the settings are set to low.

notes.content:
Hello, we're back with some more fixes.

[b]Fixed[/b]

notes.title: Patch Updates #02
notes.content:
Hey! 
24 hours after the release and we managed to fix the majority of the issues we came across while watching your gameplay or reading your comments! We want to thank you for such a great community! Here's what we fixed on this version:

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the automatic reload of the oxygen capsule wouldn't work if the player didn't opened the inventory screen first.
[*] Observe areas will now play even when subtitles are disabled from the menu settings
[*] Fixed a candle that couldn't be interacted outside of Alegra Offices
Fixed a bug where loading the game would cause candles to switch to their default state (unlit)
[*] Fixed a door that was turning on the wrong axis at Bennets House
[*] Fixed a bug where the flashlight would hide when reloading batteries
[*] Fixed a bug where while going through narrow spaces the brightness of the camera would change
[/list]

[b]Fixed but still under further testing[/b]
[list]
[*] A bug fix where the game will load in lower graphics
[*] Sometimes when opening Journal you could still control Peter in the back.
[*] The mouse will lock on some widgets at the center of the screen
[/list]

[i]If you're still having any of the above issues please contact us or leave a comment below![/i]

[b]Known issues and things in our list for the next updates[/b]

[list]
[*] Rerender all movies into 60 FPS
[*] Reload animation will calculate how many bullets have been shot in order to play in less time.
[/list]

That's all for now, we'll get back with more updates and fixes soon!

Please don't forget that this is our first game and we appreciate all of you for supporting us and being so positive while we fix all issues. Keep being so awesome!

Have a great day!
RedSoup

notes.title: New updated version of the demo coming out in May
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

We are very happy to launch our website with some wonderful news and progress from Westwood Shadows.
It’s been a pleasure to receive all your feedback and comments from the pre-alpha version of the demo. We read each and every comment from people who played or watched the game from YouTubers and we encourage all of you to send us your thoughts.

In the meantime we decided to refine the story and work on the mechanics and all the missing parts from that demo. We are happy to announce that the new demo is almost complete and will be available by the end of next month.
Before that we wanted to update you with a list of all the features added and what is now different from the pre-alpha version of the game.
[h3]
“[i]We are happy to announce that the new demo is almost complete and will be available by the end of next month.[/i]”[/h3]

The list below only shows what has been already implemented in the demo but there are still features that will be included in the full game and will be revealed in time.

[list]
[*] New intro cinematic
[*] Peter Bennet’s model
[*] The Fosters mansion design was updated to reflect the story better
[*] Cabinets and drawers can now be interacted and there are elements that the player can find through researching
[*] New cinematic for the first encounter with a shadow
[*] Introduction to Sanity regeneration system
[*] New UI for the main menu, save-load screen
[*] New UI and functionality for player’s Inventory and Journal system
[*] Fixed the saving and loading system
[*] Fixed Frame drops issue
[/list]

Thank you all for being a part of this and we will be back soon with more updates!
Redsoup

notes.title: Development update #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35457401/cb69515ddf159c45ea77687218093de988a404f9.jpg[/img]

Dear friends,  

We are very excited about all the positive feedback and some extremely helpful advice and suggestions from all of you who played the first demo of Westwood Shadows!

When we first started this game it was just 2 people with no experience at all in making games but with a lot of passion and many stories to tell! We then released the demo to start getting feedback and this happened. Suddenly this game started to draw more attention and love from people around the world.  

It is your love and support that drove us into making a few decisions. First of all, the User Interfaces are getting a redesign. We consulted many gamers and we put a lot of thinking into making the user experience, as pleasant and easy to use as possible. 

The inventory and Journal of the game were the first Interfaces to be redesigned and recoded. Below is a screenshot of the Journal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35457401/81fc7af8ac1279918098cfd99896a78a7f5e38e1.jpg[/img]

The coding of the game as it was by the time of the release of the demo has been fully replaced with a much more efficient and clean version. This fixes the issues with some frame lagging and overall feel during gameplay.  Saving and loading the game has also been implemented with new User Interface as seen below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35457401/0cadd07bb972f35e9f50fbea64b8e74e6a659ef2.jpg[/img]

[i]*Difficulty mode is something we are still considering but is not it our current list of things to do. We would love to hear your thoughts about this in the comments. 
[/i]
Most of the re-design of the core of the game is complete but there are still lots to do. Therefore the release of the game will be transferred for 2021.

Before we wrap up this post we wanted to thank you all again for playing the first demo by sharing this compilation we made out of the videos you shared!

[previewyoutube=p0YsZZvndkc;full][/previewyoutube]

Till the next time we hope you all stay safe and enjoy gaming!
We will keep you posted with further spoiler-free updates! 

Redsoup team

notes.title: Game Development Update #01
notes.content:
[h1]Let's Catch up[/h1]
It's been a month after we released Westwood Shadows Proof of concept gameplay to all our mailing list subscribers ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1122360/announcements/detail/1593633841013414708]previous announcement[/url]) and there are already videos on YouTube from players around the world ([url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLWDxrALjhwXij8KTs_iRCWgPELcY6Atcf]link[/url]). We had a lot of helpful comments and feedback from gamers and YouTubers. We would like to thank you all for playing the demo and sharing your thoughts with us.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

[b] New demo to be released[/b]
We will take all the comments we got, fix all the bugs and problems and we will finish the second level of the game with much more advanced mechanisms. This will be also publicly available to all.


[b]Development Updates[/b]

Westwood Shadows is our first game so we are constantly updating the game experience based on your feedback. After gathering a lot of helpful comments we have started working on changes and improvements and we are planning to keep you updated on the development. You can follow the track of the game from here on Steam or receive email updates and get notified when we release the next demo. 

[b]List of updates we are currently working on[/b]
[olist]
[*] [b]Story leads[/b]
     Throughout the first level of the game, one of the main goals was to get the player familiar with the story and introduce the main character, Peter Bennet. This was mostly achieved but we are still working on some clarifications regarding supporting character's background (family of Peter and the Fosters) and level design elements that were unclear

[*] [b]Interaction icon[/b]
     We have noticed a lot of people having hard time understanding how the interaction icon works. Until now the players would see an icon on top of the items that can be interacted. This will change into a much more easy way to understand which items the player can interact with. 

[*] [b]More interactable items[/b]
     More items along the game will be available for inspection or collection.  

[*] [b]Settings menu with functional graphics and sound control[/b]
     So far the demo has an automatic detection of graphics so it's adjusting to the computer automatically based on the capabilities. This will remain and the player will also have full control to adjust the graphics and sound.

[*] [b]Inventory / Journal redesign[/b]
     The current version of the inventory will get updated so the player will have access to firearms and flashlight as well. 

[*] [b]Gun Mechanics[/b]
     In the new demo the player will have the option to confront the "shadows" therefore there will be firearms and ammo.

[*] [b]NPC (Non Playable Characters) addition[/b]
     The "Shadows" will come alive! 

[*] [b]Key binding option [/b]
     The crouch button will switch from the "alt" key to the "ctr" key. Key binding menu will be added to the game so the player can re-assign all keys to what feels better.
[/olist]

See you all in our next update!
RedSoup
